name: TRIDENT
fullName: Three Low-Dose Antihypertensive Agents in a Single Pill after Intracerebral Hemorrhage
teachingPoint: A simplified low-dose triple pill after ICH lowers recurrent stroke and CV events — supports intensive, simplified BP-lowering.

name: RESTART
fullName: REstart or STop Antithrombotics Randomised Trial — antiplatelet therapy after intracerebral haemorrhage
population: n=537, ≥18, NIHSS ICH survivors, randomized a median of 76 days (IQR 29-146) after ICH; followed up to 5 years
finding: Fewer recurrences with antiplatelet therapy: 4% (12/268) vs 9% (23/268)
teachingPoint: Restarting antiplatelet therapy after ICH did not raise recurrent hemorrhage; the risk is likely outweighed by secondary-prevention benefit.
